description: This file defines a Python class `GoogleGenAIConfig` that provides configuration and transformation utilities for integrating Google models (specifically Google GenAI and Vertex AI Gemini) within a larger LLM framework. It handles parameter mapping, environment validation, authentication, request transformation, and response processing for Google-based LLM calls.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for integrating Google GenAI models into a larger LLM ecosystem, providing methods for parameter mapping, environment validation, authentication, request transformation, and response processing.
